translation: In the condition of injury with pain of the lower abdomen drawing up to the penis, this is caused by stagnant blood not moving, together with depressed fire of the liver channel. One should use Minor Bupleurum Decoction (小柴胡湯) with added rhubarb (大黃), coptis (黃連), and gardenia (山梔) and take it. After the pain has settled, then use blood-nourishing formulas, and it will naturally heal without fail.
